# SchoolPilot

SchoolPilot is Nigeria's leading AI-powered school management platform built for primary, secondary, and tertiary institutions across Nigeria.

## What It Does

- Student enrollment and profile management
- Attendance tracking with real-time parent notifications
- Automated report card generation and result publication
- School fees collection and financial reconciliation
- CBT (Computer Based Test) exam creation and grading
- Parent-school communication portal
- Staff payroll and HR management
- Library and inventory management

## Who It Is For

School administrators, teachers, parents, and students in Nigerian schools looking for a single platform to manage all school operations.
